scope: Read-only review of newly added public source package. No model run, core edit, merge, push or tag in this audit.
receipt_note: Records without hashes include documented failed, not-downloaded or not-archived requests. They are not treated as successful source retrievals.

confirmed_additions.boundary: Published ordinary tariff schedules; actual customer category and applicable heating policy still need selection.
Published procurement and price references; not 89 comparable equipment quotations, nor target-project quotations.
Performance thresholds are available. Same-model price and measured performance identity remain unjoined.
National standard schedules, material properties and public building references are available. Some extracted entries and effective-capacity calculations need correction before model use.
Includes project documents, fuel prices, cost reviews and subsidies with different years and scopes; not 185 independent parameters for one complete case.
Captured responses and derived CSV agree. Exact model selection and station-observation identity need qualification.

priority_corrections.finding: Kitchen occupancy omits 12:00 at 100 percent from GB55015 table C.0.6-6.
priority_corrections.action: Re-extract and verify the complete 24-hour sequence against the source table.

priority_corrections.finding: Summer-hot/winter-cold bedroom schedule omits active 21-24h; living-room schedule incorrectly extends 8-20h service to 8-24h.
priority_corrections.action: Correct both heating and cooling schedules against GB55015 table C.0.6-2 before mapping Wuhan services.

priority_corrections.file: 12_服务日程与热容/sources/推导脚本_热容计算.py
priority_corrections.finding: The cap is applied independently to each material layer; there is no cumulative inward depth, interior/exterior-side identification or insulation stopping logic. Seventeen ISO-effective derived records do not establish verified effective RC capacity.
priority_corrections.action: Separate full-thickness material capacity from effective dynamic capacity, correct the method and validate the selected RC parameterization. Keep layer thickness and area ratios explicitly hypothetical.

priority_corrections.finding: Urban summer window-opening duration >=13h is recorded as 44.4 percent, but source bins are 14.4 percent at 13-18h plus 44.4 percent at 19-24h, totaling 58.8 percent.
priority_corrections.action: Correct the aggregation and retain the survey population/time scope; do not label it target-building hourly measurement.

priority_corrections.finding: Request URLs do not specify models=era5. Meteostat hourly inventory is absent for 51463 and 53915 while model inventory is present. The current package does not establish two independent observed sources confirming a NASA bias.
priority_corrections.action: Record model choice and point-level observation/fill flags, use matched source identities and clocks, then rerun comparisons. Do not automatically apply a bias adjustment.

priority_corrections.finding: Both files contain 404 HTML, not the data formats suggested by their names.
priority_corrections.action: Keep failure records but exclude these files from data ingestion.

priority_corrections.file: 11_经济边界/sources/D_新疆电采暖电价通知_新发改规2024-6号_昌吉市政府网.html
priority_corrections.finding: Ordinary Xinjiang tariff table does not apply the nonresidential heating valley-period transmission/distribution discount. Residential 0.22 tariff is conditional and cannot be applied to a heating company by default.
priority_corrections.action: Bind case/customer identity and billing components before constructing applicable hourly tariffs. Preserve published ordinary tables.

priority_corrections.file: 11_经济边界/sources/B_八钢低温余热回收利用招标公告.html
priority_corrections.finding: Priority internal/community heat use, backup during production adjustment, minimum annual settlement volume and piecewise settlement terms are already present in the source but incompletely extracted.
priority_corrections.action: Extract existing constraints first. Do not treat 154/355.4 ten-thousand GJ settlement thresholds as observed available heat capacity or automatically transfer a different agreement's 11.5 CNY/GJ price.

priority_corrections.finding: Original OSM snapshot and original query are not available. Reconstructed arithmetic and current bounding-box counts do not uniquely identify the historical extraction method. Building polygons are absent from the original building CSV layers.
priority_corrections.action: Acquire a new dated/versioned raw snapshot with building geometry and reproducible queries. Label reconstructed methods as reconstructions.

priority_corrections.finding: Five source rows have eight fields under a nine-field header; the final thermal_capacity_extracted.csv is rectangular.
priority_corrections.action: Correct or quarantine the intermediate source before regeneration so that fixed final columns are not re-corrupted.

priority_corrections.finding: Some index and backfill statements predate the completed tariff package and section 12. The final admission table needs one consistent current status.
priority_corrections.action: Update the backfill matrix from source-level review, preserving dated historical notes.

priority_corrections.finding: The compared quantity is NASA minus Open-Meteo, not ERA5 minus NASA. Temperature differences are +2.36537, +0.01743, +0.11141 C for Urumqi, Guyuan, Wuhan, using 43840 matched hours.
priority_corrections.source_identity: D:/competion/xiaotiao/三城市数据包/三城市论文核验数据包_20261002/verified_public/weather_hourly uses verified UTC before conversion to Beijing time. This does not automatically validate the current V10 LST input identity.
priority_corrections.action: Correct names and sign, preserve exact input identities, and redo observed-source comparison only after station fill/model flags are established.
